news.title: Ports Giant DP World Redraws Hormuz Logistics With Truck Bet
news.summary: Ports giant DP World is expanding its overland logistics network in a bet that shipping through the Strait of Hormuz — vital for its flagship container and industrial hub in the United Arab Emirates — won’t return to the status quo from before the US-Iran war.
